description: CRS 942 (SQL Injection) false-positive samples observed during the Phase 1 reliability load test (200 RPS for 5 min, FP rate ~0.3%). These are legitimate user-traffic shapes that the SQLi rule family flags. They are the candidate set for the next round of rule tuning (see docs/phase1/waf-tuning-plan.md).

samples.comment: Korean reviews / English with apostrophes trip 942100/942130 (tautology heuristic) on quote+OR.
